Nearly 1,000 new jobs are soon coming to Hopedale as global shipping and logistics company Maersk prepares to open a fulfillment hub in town later this summer.

The announcement arrives as Hopedale has explored new housing and development opportunities in recent years, with officials of the cash-strapped community citing the need for additional revenue and long-term economic growth.

Maersk's 617,000-square-foot facility, at 75 Plain St., will serve as a fulfillment center for the Danish company, which manages ocean shipping, warehousing and supply chain operations for customers all over the world. Inwestycja wzmacnia zaplecze logistyczne LPP Logistics w Europie Południowo-Wschodniej.
